resources.string: LeanOS needs to be your home app to replace your launcher. Nothing leaves your phone.
Usage access lets LeanOS show screen time and enforce daily limits. Usage data stays on your phone.
Notification access lets the media card see what is playing and control it. LeanOS never reads your notifications, and nothing leaves your phone.
The Focus accessibility service powers double-tap lock, the notification swipe and daily limits. It sees which app is in front and nothing else, and nothing leaves your phone.
